name: Bahamas, The
governmentType: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

partiesListed.party: Coalition of Independents Party or COI

profile.religions: Protestant 69.9% (includes Baptist 34.9%, Anglican 13.7%, Pentecostal 8.9% Seventh Day Adventist 4.4%, Methodist 3.6%, Church of God 1.9%, Plymouth Brethren 1.6%, other Protestant 0.9%), Roman Catholic 12%, other Christian 13% (includes Jehovah's Witness 1.1%), other 0.6%, none 1.9%, unspecified 2.6
profile.legalSystem: common-law system based on the English model
profile.location: chain of islands in the North Atlantic Ocean, southeast of Florida, northeast of Cuba; note - although The Bahamas does not border the Caribbean Sea, geopolitically it is often designated as a Caribbean nation
